entry.title: Russia Turns to Crypto to Bypass Western Sanctions in Oil Trade: Reuters
entry.summary: Russia has turned to cryptocurrencies to facilitate oil trade with China and India, effectively bypassing Western sanctions in its $192 billion oil trade, Reuters reported, citing sources familiar with the matter. The country has been slowly moving deeper into the cryptocurrency space. Just this week, the Bank of Russia submitted proposals to create an experimental legal regime (ELR) lasting three years, allowing a “limited group of Russian investors” to trade cryptocurrencies. Some Russian oil firms use bitcoin, ether, and stablecoins such as Tether (USDT) to convert payments made in Chinese yuan and Indian rupees into roubles, the Reuters report said. These transactions currently represent a fraction of Russia’s oil trade. Other sanctioned countries, including Iran and Venezuela, have used crypto to maintain trade while avoiding reliance on the U.S. dollar, the dominant currency in global oil markets. Russia has developed multiple payment systems to navigate sanctions, and crypto is one of several tools the country uses. Fiat currencies remain the primary method used in Russia’s oil transactions, and other workarounds include using currencies such as the United Arab Emirates dirham, Reuters said. The report also added that even if sanctions were lifted, Russia would likely keep using crypto in its oil trades as it’s seen as a convenient, flexible tool. The country, meanwhile, is currently looking to get its largest banks to support a digital ruble for retail and commercial use. The Bank of Russia said that a ruble-backed central bank digital currency could be used as a tool against sanctions back in 2021. entry.summary: Layer-2 network ZKsync has announced that it will be sunsetting the Ignite Program, which rewarded users for providing liquidity, due to bearish market conditions. "After careful consideration, the DeFi Steering Committee (DSC) has decided to not renew Ignite for Season 2 and will be sunsetting the program starting March 17th, 2025 by turning off rewards for period 6," ZKsync posted on X. It added that the long-term vision is centered around the Elastic Network, which is composed of multiple chains within the ZKsync ecosystem. "Unfortunately we’re navigating a bearish market right now. In line with many other ecosystems, ZKsync has decided to be more conservative with spend in the short to medium term in response to these evolving conditions," it added. "To stay sustainable, we’re tightening our focus and spending smarter, rather than fighting headwinds." Total value locked (TVL) on ZKsync is down by around 50% since Jan. 30 as the wider crypto market is grappling with a correction that has seen bitcoin and ether lose 13% and 27% of their respective market caps in the past month. entry.title: S&P 500 Enters Correction Territory, What Does This Mean For Bitcoin?
entry.summary:
The S&P 500 has now entered correction territory, defined as a 10% decline from its all-time high. A further 10% drop would signal a bear market. But is it time to panic? Since Bitcoin’s creation in 2009, the S&P 500 has experienced multiple 20% corrections.
Following the 2008 global financial crisis the index had plunged nearly 60%. In 2019, amid bitcoin’s bear market, the S&P 500 declined by 20%, bitcoin fell as much as 85% from its all-time high. The covid-19 crash in March 2020 saw the index drop almost 40% with bitcoin shedding 60% of its value. Most recently in 2022, the index corrected by 25%, bitcoin bottomed out one month later after dropping by a further 25% to a cycle low of $15,000.
Historically, 10% corrections in the S&P 500 have been common. Meanwhile, bitcoin has dropped 30% from its all-time high during this correction. Looking at past bull market corrections, such declines are a normal occurrence, with the most recent 30% correction happening in August 2024 during the yen carry trade unwind.

ETH hits 16-month lows, underperforms again. Huge ETH liquidation in focus at $1127. Stablecoin market cap hits new ATH. Investors discounting stimulus: Cathie Wood. Trump to sign EO to end Operation Checkpoint 2.0. SEC looking to ease crypto firm registration rules. Senate committee to vote on stablecoin bill. Mt Gox makes second $900m+ move in a week. Coinbase to launch 24/7 perp-style futures in US. Coinbase gets license in India. Deutsche Borse to offer BTC, ETH custody services. SGP exchange rolls out open-ended BTC futures. ETH’s Pectra upgrade on Sepolia disrupted. Lazarus have laundered $300m from ByBit hack. Thai SEC approves USDT. Offchain labs to add ARB tokens to treasury. Next coins to pump will be ‘completely different’.

entry.title: BTC touches $80K, Strategy wants $21B more BTC, Banks to enter Crypto
entry.summary: BTC touches $80k then rebounds. Feed & Greed index hits 20 in ‘Extreme fear’. OCC allows banks to broadly access crypto. Strategy files $21bn perp stock issuance. Stablecoin legislation by August: Trump. Utah senate passes watered down BTC bill. US could sell gold for BTC reserve: StanChart. Sacks talks down gold selling expectations. Fold Holdings buy 475 more BTC. US Dept. of Housing contemplating adopting crypto. WLFI’s crypto losses stand at $110m. SBF moved to solitary after Tucker interview. Kraken could seek IPO as soon as 1Q 2026. BBVA to offer BTC and ETH services. Coinbase set to hire thousands in the US. Survive to win: Degen Spartan.

entry.title: BTC falls after reserve Announced, Nasdaq in correction
entry.summary: BTC falls as reserve to be funded by forfeitures. Treasury wants fiscal-neutral BTC accumulation. Selling BTC early cost US $17bn: Sacks. White House crypto summit today. Lummis BTC proposal may come next week. Texas senate passes BTC reserve bill. 50%+ chance of new BTC high by June: Klippsten. New bill aims to end crypto debanking. ETH sentiment hits yearly low. Coinbase acquires Iron Fish team to boost privacy. SBF appears on Tucker Carlson’s podcast. SUI jumps after partnership with Trump’s WLF. Canary files for SUI ETF. ByBit hack due to dev laptop being compromised. Crypto VC deals $1.1b in Feb, DeFi interest surges.

entry.title: BTC optimism returns, tariff delays, BioNexus starts ETH reserve
entry.summary: BTC rallies on tariff delay & conference optimism. BTC sentiment still in ‘Extreme Fear’. Coinbase plans to offer tokenised securities. New Hampshire BTC bill passes House committee. Falling USD signals strong Q2 for crypto: Pal. Mt. Gox moves $1bn BTC to unmarked address. BioNexus 1st public firm to get ETH treasury. New York introduces bill to criminalise rug pulls. XRP donates $50m to raise crypto awareness. ONDO rallies after CEO gets conference invite. US customs releasing seized crypto miners. Jump to restart crypto trading. Canary files for first AXL ETF. Bitwise files to launch Aptos ETF in US. Scale AI partners with Pentagon. AAVE heading towards GHO savings coin. Stablecoins above $1T by end of the year: Tomaino. S. Korea inches closer to BTC ETF decision. Brazils Meliuz plans BTC treasury. Belarus evaluating crypto mining. Argentina to freeze assets in LIBRA fraud case.

entry.title: BTC Rebounds, Reserve policy coming Friday, AVAX presales heat-up
entry.summary: BTC rebounds to above 90k, dominance rises. BTC reserve policy to be announced on Friday. BTC to be treated differently to altcoins in reserve. SOL’s new proposal slashes inflation by 80%. Crypto leaders set to attend Friday’s conference. US broker DeFi rule set to be repealed. Metaplanet buys $43m more BTC. Billionaire Salinas has 70% of wealth in BTC. Texas Senate to vote on BTC reserve. El Salvador defies IMF, continues to buy BTC. USDT storage and transfer allowed under MiCA. ETH activates Pectra update. Reddit co-founder wants to put TikTok on-chain. Across Protocol raises $41m. AAVE leads alts after announcing buyback.

entry.title: Second-worst Day ever for Crypto, Tariffs spook Markets, Reserve coins tank
entry.summary: U-turn in markets sends crypto crashing. Second-worst day for crypto ever. ‘Reserve coins’ all dump 20%+. Fear & Green index back to 24. Crypto leaders chide XRP, ADA inclusion in reserve. Rationale for ETH, SOL in reserve unclear: Bernstein. ETH/BTC ratio hits another 4-year low. Crypto ETPs see $2.9b outflow in 3-week streak. $1.4b Bybit funds laundered through Thorchain. Rumours of tax breaks for crypto announced Friday. BTC will go to $200T: Saylor. Hyperliquid ‘insider’ up $81m on ETH short. SEC introduces crypto task force members. SEC to drop case against Kraken. Coinbase probes cost of SEC’s ‘war on crypto’. NYSE Arca proposes rule change to list DOGE ETF. Tether appoints new CFO to improve transparency. SBI in Japan to support USDC. Australia has no plans for crypto strategic reserve. Vietnam to introduce crypto regulations in March.

entry.title: Crypto reserves Coming, ADA soars, XRP briefly flips ETH
entry.summary: Trump names BTC, ETH, SOL, ADA, XRP for reserve. Trump Put’ drives rally, ADA rallies 50%. XRP briefly flips ETH FDV. BTC still rises back to 62% as ETH underperforms. Bears lose $550m in Sunday liquidations. China also planning strategic reserve: Bailey. BTC best option for crypto reserve: Armstrong. Crypto reserve is just words: Hayes. Trump to make ‘investment announcement’ today BTC isn’t a worthy reserve asset: SNB president. SOL up 20% after major FTX unlock. Largest ever CME gap prints in BTC futures. Trader makes $12m on $200m perp bet. BTC ETF 8-day outflow streak finally ends. BlackRock adds BTC ETF to model portfolios. SEC again delays ETH ETF options on CBOE.

entry.title: BTC touches $78K, Tariffs Blamed, Crypto Market-cap below 2021!
entry.summary: BTC touches $78K, nearly erases election gains. Crypto market cap dips below 2021 peak. ETH now down 9% since election. BTC ETFs outflows $2.4bn so far this week. Bounces back after benign PCE inflation figure. Sell a kidney if you need, but keep Bitcoin: Saylor. Texas BTC reserve bill passes with 9-0 vote. Arizona crypto bills inch closer to law. BTC could hit $500k before Trump leaves: StanChart. SEC drops case vs Metamask, silent on XRP. SEC to drop enforcement case against Consensys. ETH Foundation hires external advisors for values. Stablecoin legislation first priority: Lummis. Metamask to add support for SOL, BTC. Base adds Flashblocks to 10x speed. ETH's upgrade on schedule despite test failure. BitMEX is reportedly up for sale. Uniswap launches offramp service with Moonpay. Coinbase, NEAR collab to develop OpenAI services. Crypto exchange BITMEX seeks buyer.

entry.title: Consensus 2025: Predicting Media Success
entry.summary: At Consensus 2025 in Hong Kong, DASTAN CEO Loxley Fernandes and President Farokh Sarmad discuss how on-chain prediction market MYRIAD's dynamic participatory model offers a new solution for aligning incentives in the media ecosystem.

entry.title: Consensus 2025: Does Crypto Have a Culture?
entry.summary: Rug Radio's Farokh Sarmad is joined by WalletConnect Foundation Founder and Director Pedro Gomes, Sophon Founder and CEO Sebastien and MOG Creative Director Mike Three for a discussion on the changing face of crypto culture and how to onboard newcomers to the space.

entry.title: Crypto Fear Peaks, Tariff talk Spooks Markets, KAITO hits $2.8B
entry.summary: Pain continues, BTC largest 3-day slide since FTX. Fear index at Celsius, LUNA, 3AC collapse levels. BlackRock BTC ETF outflow streak hit 7 days. BlackRock sell to continue ETF outflows today. SOL hits lowest RSI since 2022 then bounces. SEC drops crypto exchange Gemini probe. SEC and Justin Sun explore a ‘resolution’. Delay in timeline for crypto legislation. Washington close to crypto bills: Lummis. Bank of America set to issue stablecoin. Pi Network breaks ATH with volume $3bn. APT jumps on Bitwise Aptos ETF filing. SOL ETFs get registered on DTCC. Safe was compromised for ByBit hack. SOL inflation may soon be reduced 80%. AVAX launches credit card. Metaplanet issue $13m bonds to buy BTC.

entry.title: Crypto Remains Weak, Nvidia Results Day, DeFi Heats-up!
entry.summary: BTC rebounds off $86k, ETF outflows highest ever. ETFs outflows driven by basis unwinds. Fear & Greed hits lowest level since October. Prediction markets think only $124k BTC in 2025. Strategy now down 55% from high. SEC drops case against Uniswap. MKR leads DeFi coins after Uniswap news. Uniswap ‘biggest disaster’ in DAO governance. IP continues to lead altcoins, up 160% this week. HYPE makes $3.5m in fees in one day. Crypto market in tactical retreat, not reversal: Teng. Oklahoma BTC bill heads to floor vote. GME receives investor proposal to buy $5bn BTC. Mirana Ventures moves $600m ETH to Bybit. Aya Miyaguchi becomes ETH foundation president. SEC acknowledges revised Grayscale ETH ETF. SOL submits proposal to reduce issuance. Whale moves $198m SOL to exchanges. New SMS scam targets Binance users. Bybit hackers launder $113m in 24hrs. Circle CEO pushes for US registration of stablecoins. Competitors trying to kill Tether: Tether CEO.

Crypto plunge leads to $1.3bn in liquidations. Greed & Fear index back to ‘Extreme Fear’. ETH on verge of ‘Death Cross’ pattern. S. Dakota follows Montana, rejects BTC reserve. Ohio considers bill preventing state taxes on crypto. Bybit repays Bitget’s 40kn ETH loan. SEC acknowledges Grayscale’s ADA ETF. Canary Capital files for HBAR ETF. entry.title: Crypto Falls after Hack, SOL underperforms, Sonic & Berachain heat up
entry.summary: Crypto falls after macro-sell off and huge hack. North Korea’s Lazarus behind $1.4bn Bybit hack. Hack caused by musking attack of Safe website. Bybit’s ETH reserve’s restored after loans & buyback. Bybit offers 10% reward for returned funds. Large amounts of hacked funds already blocked. Safe moves to increase security following hack. Hacker now has more ETH than ETH Foundation. 0xInfini hacked for $50m. Calls for ETH rollback broadly dismissed. SOLBTC falls to lowest level since Dec 2023. Franklin Templeton file for SOL ETF. Binance sells large blocks of SOL via Wintermute. Berachain & Sonic lead weekly inflows. BERA passes ARB & Base in TVL. Ethena raises $100m for tradfi push. Babylon TGE likely near. ARB votes to invest 7.5k ETH in non-ARB protocols. Montana votes against BTC reserve. El Salvador set to stop BTC purchases. Strategy set to buy $2bn more BTC. Hong Kong Asia Holdings set to buy more BTC. Arkham spot trading goes live in many states. Monad testnet launches at 10k TPS.
